# x402 Slug Generator

> Deterministic text → clean URL/SEO slug for agents. Custom separator, length limits, strict mode. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC on Base).

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog – free discovery
- GET /api/slugify – service info
- POST /api/slugify – paid slug generation

## Pricing

~0.003 – 0.01 USDC per call (default max ~0.008 USDC)

## Input

```json
{
  "text": "Hello World! This is a Test Title 2026",
  "options": {
    "separator": "-",
    "lower": true,
    "maxLength": 80,
    "strict": true
  }
}
```

## Output

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "slug": "hello-world-this-is-a-test-title-2026",
  "meta": { "originalLength": 38, "slugLength": 36 }
}
```

Ideal for autonomous agents building routes, file names, cache keys, or content identifiers.
